question: A box had 480 yellow, orange, and black beads. After 18 yellow beads were added, 33 orange beads were removed, and black beads were doubled, the 3 colours were equal. Find each original count.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the aligned bars after the changes, where yellow and orange are 2 units each and black is 1 unit.

steps.title: Find one bar unit
steps.text: The bars show 5 equal units after the adjustments. Their total is 480 + 18 − 33 = 465, so 1 unit = 465 ÷ 5 = 93.

steps.title: Reverse the end pieces
steps.text: Yellow originally was 2 units minus the added 18: 2×93 − 18 = 168. Orange originally was 2 units plus the removed 33: 2×93 + 33 = 219. Black was 1 unit: 93.

zh-Hans.strategy: 看变化后的对齐单位条：黄色和橙色各是2单位，黑色是1单位。

steps.title: 求1个单位
steps.text: 变化后的3条共5个等单位，总数是480 + 18 − 33 = 465，所以1单位是465 ÷ 5 = 93。

question: 40% of Angie’s beads were red. After she lost 50 blue beads, the number of blue beads was reduced by 1/3 of its original count. How many beads did Angie have in the end?

steps.title: Read the blue bar
steps.text: The 60% blue bar is split into 3 equal 20% units. The lost 50 beads are one of those units, so 1 unit (20%) = 50 and the original blue amount is 3×50 = 150.

steps.title: Complete the whole bar
steps.text: The full 100% bar has 5 units, so it originally held 5×50 = 250 beads. After the 50 blue beads were lost, Angie had 250 − 50 = 200 beads.

question: There were 820 orange buttons, 160 fewer than yellow buttons and 210 more than green buttons. Blue buttons were 1/3 of the total. How many buttons were there altogether?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Make the three-unit bar: blue is 1 unit, while orange, yellow, and green together are the other 2 units.

steps.title: Build the 2-unit section
steps.text: Yellow = 820 + 160 = 980 and green = 820 − 210 = 610. Thus orange + yellow + green = 820 + 980 + 610 = 2410; this is the 2-unit section of the bar.

steps.title: Complete all 3 units
steps.text: 1 unit = 2410 ÷ 2 = 1205. The whole bar has 3 units, so the total is 3×1205 = 3615 buttons.

zh-Hans.strategy: 画3单位条：蓝色是1单位，橙、黄、绿合起来是另2单位。

question: 160 paperclips were in 4 boxes A, B, C, and D. 12 paperclips were moved from A to B, 1/3 of the paperclips in B were moved to C, and 17 paperclips were moved from D to C. The boxes then contained equal numbers of paperclips. Find the original number in each box.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Start with the final equal boxes, then follow the linked transfer bars backward.

steps.title: Read the final boxes
steps.text: Each final box has 160 ÷ 4 = 40 paperclips. Reversing the direct transfers gives A = 40 + 12 = 52 and D = 40 + 17 = 57.

steps.title: Use B's 2-unit and 3-unit bars
steps.text: The upper B bar shows 2 units = 40, so 1 unit = 20. Before one third was moved to C, B was 3 units = 60; undo the 12 moved from A: B = 60 − 12 = 48.

steps.title: Finish C's split bar
steps.text: C's final 40-bar contains 20 from B and 17 from D. Its original part is 40 − 20 − 17 = 3.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先读出最后4个相等的盒子，再沿着相连的转移单位条倒推。

steps.title: 读出最后每盒数量
steps.text: 最后每盒有160 ÷ 4 = 40个回形针。倒推直接转移，A原来有40 + 12 = 52个，D原来有40 + 17 = 57个。

steps.title: 使用B的2单位和3单位条
steps.text: B的上条显示2单位=40，所以1单位=20。移到C之前，B是3单位=60；再倒回从A移入的12个，B原来有60 − 12 = 48个。

steps.title: 完成C的分段条
steps.text: C最后的40个由从B来的20个、从D来的17个和原有部分组成，所以原有40 − 20 − 17 = 3个。

question: Michael had 80% more money than Alvin; Vanessa had 40% less. Michael and Alvin gave Vanessa money in a 3:2 ratio. Vanessa then had 2 times her original amount; Michael ended $144 above Vanessa. Find original amounts.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use Alvin's 100% as the baseline, then use the 3:2 transfer strip and the final comparison bars.

steps.title: Set up the percentage bars
steps.text: The initial bars are Michael 180%, Alvin 100%, and Vanessa 60%. Vanessa doubles to 120%, so the amount transferred to her is 120% − 60% = 60%.

steps.title: Split the 60% transfer
steps.text: The M:A strip has 3 + 2 = 5 equal parts. Thus 1 part = 60% ÷ 5 = 12%; Michael gives 3×12% = 36% and Alvin gives 2×12% = 24%.

steps.title: Use the final difference
steps.text: On the stacked bars, Michael's 180% minus Vanessa's 120% minus Michael's 36% transfer leaves 24%, and this is $144. Thus 1% = $144 ÷ 24 = $6. The original amounts are 180×$6 = $1080, 100×$6 = $600, and 60×$6 = $360.

steps.text: M:A比例条共有3 + 2 = 5份，所以1份是60% ÷ 5 = 12%。Michael给3×12% = 36%，Alvin给2×12% = 24%。

steps.text: 对齐条中，Michael的180%减Vanessa的120%，再减Michael转出的36%，余24%= $144。因此1%= $144 ÷ 24 = $6。原来Michael有180×$6 = $1080，Alvin有100×$6 = $600，Vanessa有60×$6 = $360。

question: David had 3/7 as many cards as Kristy. David gave away 9 cards and Kristy bought 18 cards. Their final numbers of cards were in the ratio 2:9. How many cards did they have altogether in the end?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the expanded 6:27 ratio bars and the rearranged Kristy strip.

steps.title: Expand the final ratio
steps.text: The 2:9 ratio is enlarged by 3 to 6:27, so the two final bars contain 33 equal units altogether. In the rearranged Kristy bar, 27 − 14 = 13 units remain to be valued.

steps.title: Value the rearranged section
steps.text: The seven repeated 3-card cells give 3×7 = 21 cards. Together with the bought 18 cards, this is 21 + 18 = 39 cards, matching the 13-unit section.

steps.title: Complete the 33-unit brace
steps.text: 13 units = 39, so 1 unit = 3. The full 33-unit brace is 33×3 = 99 cards.

steps.title: 给重排部分定值
steps.text: 7个重复的“3”卡片格共有3×7 = 21张；再加买入的18张，得到21 + 18 = 39张，正好对应13单位。

question: 2/3 of 42 students passed English. Of those who passed, 9/14 were girls. There were 4 more boys than girls among the students who failed. How many girls were in the class?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: First find the total who failed, then use the two-row failure bar with the extra 4 boys.

steps.title: Find the failure total
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The fraction who failed is 1 − 2/3 = 1/3. Thus 1/3×42 = 14 students failed.

steps.title: Split the failure bars
steps.text: The boys row has an extra terminal block of 4. Remove it from the total: 14 − 4 = 10. The two equal girls-and-boys parts are 10 ÷ 2 = 5, so 5 girls failed.

steps.title: Add the passing girls
steps.text: 2/3×42 = 28 students passed, and 9/14×28 = 18 of them were girls. Total girls = 18 + 5 = 23.

steps.title: 分开两条失败人数条

topic: The Four Operations of Whole Numbers
question: 105 students were in 3 groups. 1/3 of group 1 moved to group 2, and 20% of group 3 moved to group 2. Then 15 students moved from group 1 to group 3. The 3 groups then had equal numbers of students. Find the original number in each group.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the equal final group size, then read the 80%/20% transfer bar and the 3-unit group-1 bar.

steps.title: Find group 3 from its percentage bar
steps.text: Each final group has 105 ÷ 3 = 35 students. After 15 arrive from group 1, group 3 had 35 − 15 = 20; this is the 80% part of its bar. The 20% transferred to group 2 is 20 ÷ 80×20 = 5, so group 3 originally had 20 + 5 = 25.

steps.title: Find group 1 from its 3-unit bar
steps.text: Before the final 15 left group 1, it had 35 + 15 = 50 students. This is the 2-unit part after 1/3 moved away, so 1 unit = 50 ÷ 2 = 25 and group 1 originally had 3×25 = 75.

steps.title: Find group 2
steps.text: Group 2 receives 25 from group 1 and 5 from group 3, then ends with 35. Its original number was 35 − 25 − 5 = 5.

steps.title: 从百分比条求第3组
steps.text: 最后每组有105 ÷ 3 = 35人。第3组先有35 − 15 = 20人，这对应条中的80%。转到第2组的20%是20 ÷ 80×20 = 5人，所以第3组原来有20 + 5 = 25人。

steps.title: 从3单位条求第1组
steps.text: 第1组最后转走15人之前有35 + 15 = 50人，这是转走1/3后留下的2单位。所以1单位=50 ÷ 2 = 25人，第1组原来有3×25 = 75人。

steps.title: 求第2组
steps.text: 第2组从第1组收到25人，从第3组收到5人，最后有35人。因此原来有35 − 25 − 5 = 5人。

question: Joanne sold cookies, cakes, and muffins. There were 140 more cookies than cakes. 1/5 of the cookies and 2/3 of the cakes were chocolate. The number of chocolate cookies equalled the number of chocolate cakes. The number of butter cakes equalled the number of butter muffins. The number of cakes was 3/4 of the number of muffins. (a) How many more butter items than chocolate items were there? (b) If a cookie cost $0.50, a cake cost $1.50, and a muffin cost $2, what were the total sales?
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the flavour-coded unit bars: cookies have 10 units, cakes 3 units, and muffins 4 units.

steps.title: Count the flavour units
steps.text: Use 1/5 = 2/10 to show 2 chocolate units in the 10-unit cookie bar. The cake bar has 2 chocolate and 1 butter unit; the muffin bar has 3 chocolate and 1 butter unit. Thus chocolate has 2 + 2 + 3 = 7 units, while butter has 8 + 1 + 1 = 10 units.

steps.title: Value the bars
steps.text: The 7 chocolate units equal 140, so 1 unit = 140 ÷ 7 = 20. Butter totals 10×20 = 200, so butter exceeds chocolate by 200 − 140 = 60 items.

question: 4656 people attended a concert. After 1/4 of men and 1/3 of women left, 120 more women remained. How many more women than men were there at first?
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the two aligned remaining-person bars as 5 equal men units and 4 equal women units plus four extra blocks of 120.

steps.title: Remove the four extra blocks
steps.text: The bars together show 9 equal units plus 4 × 120 people. So the 9 equal units are 4656 − 4 × 120 = 4176.

steps.title: Find one bar unit
steps.text: Each equal unit is 4176 ÷ 9 = 464 people. The men bar is 5 × 464 = 2320, while the women bar is 4 × 464 + 480 = 2336.

steps.title: Compare the two bars
steps.text: The women bar exceeds the men bar by 2336 − 2320 = 16.

question: 1/3 of 120 oranges were ripe and the rest overripe. After 40 were removed, overripe oranges were 3/4 of the remainder. Find removed ripe, removed overripe, and final difference.
hint: Underline the given values. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the first thirds bar for the original oranges, then the second 4-unit bar for the 80 oranges left.

steps.title: Read the original thirds bar
steps.text: One of the 3 equal parts is ripe: 120 ÷ 3 = 40 ripe oranges. The other 2 parts are overripe: 2 × 40 = 80.

steps.title: Read the remaining 4-unit bar
steps.text: After 40 oranges are removed, 80 remain. The bar has 4 equal units, so 1 unit is 80 ÷ 4 = 20; its 3 overripe units are 3 × 20 = 60.

steps.title: Compare each type
steps.text: Overripe removed = 80 − 60 = 20. Ripe remaining is 1 unit = 20, so ripe removed = 40 − 20 = 20; the final difference is 60 − 20 = 40.

steps.text: 3 个相等部分中有 1 部分是成熟橙子：120 ÷ 3 = 40 个。另 2 部分是过熟橙子：2 × 40 = 80 个。

steps.title: 读剩下的 4 等分条
steps.text: 取走 40 个后剩 80 个。该条有 4 个相等单位，所以 1 个单位是 80 ÷ 4 = 20；其中 3 个过熟单位是 3 × 20 = 60。

steps.text: 取走的过熟橙子为 80 − 60 = 20 个。剩下的成熟橙子为 1 个单位，即 20 个，所以取走的成熟橙子为 40 − 20 = 20 个；最后相差 60 − 20 = 40 个。

steps.title: Extend the education block to 6 months

question: Frankie, Martin, and Jeremy earned $120. Jeremy earned 1/2 Frankie; Martin earned 3 times Jeremy and gave Frankie 1/4 of his money. Jeremy then earned 4 times his earlier amount. How much more did Jeremy have?
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Read the Before bars as 2, 3, and 1 equal units, then follow the arrow and compare the End bars.

steps.title: Find the value of a unit
steps.text: Before the transfer, Frankie, Martin, and Jeremy have 2 + 3 + 1 = 6 units worth $120. So 1 unit is $120 ÷ 6 = $20.

steps.title: Follow the transfer arrow
steps.text: Martin's 3 units are $60, and the arrow marks 1/4 of this as $15. Frankie therefore changes from 2 units to 2 × $20 + $15 = $55.

steps.title: Compare the End bars
steps.text: Jeremy's End bar has 4 units, or 4 × $20 = $80. The final difference is $80 − $55 = $25.

en.answerCheck: Check: Jeremy has $80 and Frankie has $55, so Jeremy had $25 more.

zh-Hans.strategy: 把 Before 的三条金额条读作 2、3、1 个相等单位，再沿箭头处理转给 Frankie 的钱，并比较 End 的两条金额条。

steps.title: 求每个单位的金额
steps.text: 转钱前，Frankie、Martin、Jeremy 的单位数为 2 + 3 + 1 = 6，共 $120。因此 1 个单位为 $120 ÷ 6 = $20。

steps.title: 沿转账箭头计算
steps.text: Martin 的 3 个单位是 $60，箭头标示其中的 1/4 为 $15。Frankie 因而由 2 个单位变为 2 × $20 + $15 = $55。

steps.title: 比较 End 的金额条
steps.text: Jeremy 的 End 条有 4 个单位，即 4 × $20 = $80。最后相差 $80 − $55 = $25。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：Jeremy 有 $80，Frankie 有 $55，所以 Jeremy 多 $25。

question: A 90 cm × 10 cm tank was filled by taps at 4 L/min and 10 L per 2 min. After 1.5 min it was 1/4 full. Find tank height.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the two-row flow table to get the one shaded quarter of the tank, then scale the tank bar to full capacity.

steps.title: Merge the two tap rates
steps.text: Using the visual model above, Tap A supplies 4 L/min. Tap B supplies 10 L ÷ 2 min = 5 L/min, so together they supply 9 L/min. In 1.5 min they deliver 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³.

steps.title: Scale the shaded quarter
steps.text: The shaded section is 1 of 4 equal tank-capacity parts. Thus the full tank volume is 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³.

steps.title: Use the base rectangle
steps.text: The base area is 90 × 10 = 900 cm². Height = full volume ÷ base area = 54000 ÷ 900 = 60 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 900 cm² × 60 cm = 54000 cm³, so the tank height is 60 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 用两行进水速率表求水箱中涂色的 1/4，再把容量条放大到全满。

steps.title: 合并两个水龙头的流速
steps.text: 结合上面的图示模型，水龙头 A 每 min 流 4 L。水龙头 B 每 2 min 流 10 L，即 10 L ÷ 2 min = 5 L/min，所以合共 9 L/min。1.5 min 流入 9 × 1.5 = 13.5 L = 13500 cm³。

steps.text: 涂色部分是水箱 4 个相等容量部分中的 1 个。因此水箱全满容积为 4 × 13500 = 54000 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：900 cm² × 60 cm = 54000 cm³，所以水箱高是 60 cm。

question: PQRS is enlarged to VWRT; area increases 226 cm². PQRS length is 2 times breadth. Find PQRS perimeter.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the nested-rectangle diagram: remove the 4 cm by 4 cm corner square, then express the two remaining added rectangles with PQ = 2PS.

steps.title: Remove the corner square
steps.text: The two 4 cm extensions make the highlighted corner a 4 cm × 4 cm square of area 16 cm². The two other added rectangles therefore have area 226 − 16 = 210 cm².

steps.title: Use the two added rectangles
steps.text: Their areas are 4 × PS and 4 × PQ, so 4PS + 4PQ = 210. The diagram gives PQ = 2PS, hence 4PS + 4(2PS) = 210 and 12PS = 210.

steps.title: Find the original perimeter
steps.text: PS = 17.5 cm and PQ = 35 cm. Thus the perimeter of PQRS is 2 × (17.5 + 35) = 105 cm.

en.answerCheck: Check: 4 × 17.5 + 4 × 35 + 16 = 226, and the perimeter is 105 cm.

zh-Hans.strategy: 使用嵌套矩形图：先扣除 4 cm × 4 cm 的角正方形，再用 PQ = 2PS 表示余下的 2 个新增长方形。

steps.text: 两条 4 cm 的扩边形成高亮的 4 cm × 4 cm 角正方形，面积为 16 cm²。因此另外 2 个新增长方形的面积为 226 − 16 = 210 cm²。

steps.title: 使用 2 个新增长方形
steps.text: 它们的面积分别为 4 × PS 和 4 × PQ，所以 4PS + 4PQ = 210。图中给出 PQ = 2PS，因此 4PS + 4(2PS) = 210，即 12PS = 210。

steps.title: 求原矩形的周长
steps.text: PS = 17.5 cm，PQ = 35 cm。因此 PQRS 的周长为 2 × (17.5 + 35) = 105 cm。

question: Tank A was 30% full. 2/5 of its water filled 1/2 of empty tank B, sized 15 cm × 12 cm × 25 cm. How much water is now needed to fill A?
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the first 5-part bar to recover tank A's initial water from the transfer, then use the 10-part percent bar to find full capacity.

steps.title: Label the transferred two fifths
steps.text: Tank B holds 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³, so its half-full amount is 2250 cm³. On A's first bar, this is 2 of the 5 equal initial-water parts.

steps.title: Complete the first bar
steps.text: One fifth is 2250 ÷ 2 = 1125 cm³, so all 5 initial parts total 5 × 1125 = 5625 cm³. The 3 untransferred parts are 3 × 1125 = 3375 cm³.

steps.title: Read the 10% bar
steps.text: The 5625 cm³ initial amount is 30%, or 3 of 10 equal percent parts. Thus full capacity is 5625 ÷ 3 × 10 = 18750 cm³, and the water needed is 18750 − 3375 = 15375 cm³.

en.answerCheck: Check: 30% of 18750 cm³ is 5625 cm³; after 2250 cm³ is transferred, 15375 cm³ is needed to fill A.

zh-Hans.strategy: 先用第一个 5 等分条从倒出的水量还原 A 原有水量，再用 10 个百分比格求满箱容积。

steps.title: 标出倒出的 2/5
steps.text: 水箱 B 的容积为 15 × 12 × 25 = 4500 cm³，半满为 2250 cm³。在 A 的第一条中，这就是原有水量的 5 个相等部分中的 2 个。

steps.title: 读 10% 百分比条
steps.text: 原有的 5625 cm³ 是 30%，即 10 个相等百分比格中的 3 格。因此满箱容积为 5625 ÷ 3 × 10 = 18750 cm³，所需水量为 18750 − 3375 = 15375 cm³。

zh-Hans.answerCheck: 验算：18750 cm³ 的 30% 是 5625 cm³；倒出 2250 cm³ 后，装满 A 还需 15375 cm³。

question: Patrick, Jemima, Angela had $482. Angela had 3/4 of Jemima; after Patrick used $125, he had 1/4 less than Jemima. Find initial Patrick-plus-Angela total.
hint: Label each money amount. Draw equal units, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Use the three aligned money bars: Patrick after spending has 6 units, Jemima has 8, Angela has 3, and the separate $125 block restores the original total.

steps.title: Read the total brace

steps.text: Using the visual model above, Triangle PQR has base PQ = 12 cm and height 36 cm, so its area is 12 × 36 ÷ 2 = 216 cm².

steps.text: The semicircle radius is 12 ÷ 2 = 6 cm, so its area is 1/2 × 3.14 × 6² = 56.52 cm². The lower triangle height is 36 − 6 − 5 = 25 cm, so its area is 8 × 25 ÷ 2 = 100 cm².

question: A 70 cm × 45 cm × 50 cm tank filled from 2 taps at 7 L/min each for 10 min. 30% was poured into a tub to make it 3/10 full. Find water needed to fill both.
hint: Label the given measures. Draw a model, then calculate the requested value.

en.strategy: Follow the flow timeline to 140 L, then use the 4-part tub bar and 10-part tank bar to add the two empty amounts.

steps.title: Follow the flow timeline
steps.text: Using the visual model above, The two taps give 7 + 7 = 14 L/min. In 10 min they collect 14 × 10 = 140 L = 140000 cm³. The tub receives 30% of this, or 42 L.

steps.title: Read the 4-part tub bar
steps.text: The 42 L fills 3 of 4 equal tub parts. One part is 42 ÷ 3 = 14 L, so the empty tub part is 14 L = 14000 cm³.

steps.title: Read the 10-part tank bar and add
steps.text: The tank retains 70% of 140 L = 98 L = 98000 cm³. Its full capacity is 70 × 45 × 50 = 157500 cm³, so its empty amount is 157500 − 98000 = 59500 cm³. Total needed is 59500 + 14000 = 73500 cm³ = 73.5 L.
